localChanges: When a city uses more Food, Production or Gold than it makes, the city screen now shows the shortfall as dark red icons after the greyed-out ones, so a city paying 6 Gold of upkeep from 5 shows five grey coins and one red (closes #188).
On the city screen, keys 1 to 8 change the type of the first to eighth specialist, as clicking it does (closes #107).
